specs.title: / renders main TodoMVC page with header and input
/active renders the active filter page
/completed renders the completed filter page
unknown route renders 404 Not Found page
typing text and pressing Enter adds a todo to the list
new todo is prepended (appears at the top of the list)
adding a todo increments the item count in the footer
whitespace-only input does NOT create a todo
input field clears after a successful creation
adding multiple todos creates all of them
clicking destroy button removes the todo from the list
deleting a todo decrements the item count
deleting the last todo hides the footer and list
clicking checkbox marks a todo as completed (gets completed CSS class)
clicking checkbox again un-completes a todo
completing a todo decrements the remaining-count display
completing all todos individually shows Clear completed button
toggle-all marks all todos as complete
unchecking toggle-all marks all todos as incomplete
single click on label enters edit mode
edit mode shows current text in the edit input
typing new text + Enter saves and updates the label
pressing Escape in edit mode closes edit without losing a valid value
blurring edit input with valid text saves the edit
blurring edit input with empty text deletes the todo
footer shows correct item count when todos exist
All filter link navigates to / and shows all todos
Active filter link navigates to /active and hides completed todos
Completed filter link navigates to /completed and hides active todos
selected filter link has "selected" class
Clear completed button is hidden when no todos are completed
Clear completed button appears when at least one todo is completed
Clear completed button removes all completed todos
footer disappears when all todos are deleted
todos survive a page reload
completed state survives a page reload
fresh page has no todo items, no footer, no list
header and input are always visible even with empty list
